🔴 The Red Mystery Boxes

Choose your own sealed box, then select another box to open. The Banker rings before that box opens.
HOW TO PLAY: Choose one of 22 sealed boxes to keep. The Banker rings only after you select another box to open, before revealing it, offers a vague non-revealing hint, and offers a mystery prompt. DEAL accepts the offered prompt and ends the game; NO DEAL rejects it and continues. At the final two boxes, keep yours or swap. Your own box is never revealed before the finale.
